# ---- the mesh engine the plan asked for, and why it was abandoned ----
# lambda = spectral radius of the BlockCert 'hits' block graph on a uniform mesh
# of N cells over [0,ell).  Every entry exceeds 3/2, i.e. every such certificate is
# weaker than the free bound.  Refinement does not help: at ell=1/2 the value is
# exactly 2 at every N, because a uniform mesh is self-similar under a
# piecewise-linear map of slope 3/2.
#   ell \ N      8       16      32      64      128     256     512
#   2/5      1.89468 1.73363 1.67887 1.80982 1.75265 1.77873 1.79802
#   5/12     1.98098 1.82334 1.86620 1.92981 1.94200 1.93049 1.91609
#   11/24    2.09544 1.91283 2.02145 1.99238 2.01081 1.99928 2.00991
#   23/48    2.07326 1.99219 2.05817 2.04272 2.02751 2.05404 2.04777
#   1/2      2.00000 2.00000 2.00000 2.00000 2.00000 2.00000 2.00000
